rationale: The workflow already caches the Maven dependency repository (~/.m2/repository) keyed by runner OS and pom.xml hash, so the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache optimization is already present; its contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies and adding another cache would be an unrelated change. The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST option (fail-fast: true) is not suitable because this is a cross-OS/cross-JDK Java CI whose non-experimental matrix cells are all required to verify compatibility; cancelling remaining matrix jobs on the first failure would reduce intended build/test coverage, matching the contraindication "Every matrix outcome is required." P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not supported because there is no representative successful-duration history to set a safe bound, and valid slow runs (especially Windows/macOS across multiple JDKs) could exceed it. No other retrieved pattern preserves coverage while offering a supported, minimal change here.
